dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: Hey, you over there... and your little minion too... Could you please stop for a moment? I'd like to share something with you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you talking to me?

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: Yes, you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who's she calling a minion...? Oh, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: Yes, the two of you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's not a minion, gee. We're traveling together... Anyway, what do you want to tell us?

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: ...I'm actually scouting for suitable guests.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guests?

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: Yes. I'm from the House of Hesperides in the mountains. That's the residence of Lady Pavlina, princess of the Snegovik, and other fae...

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: And now, we're looking for... exalted guests to attend the princess's wedding. That's why I've been sent down here to look for the most suitable and worthy individuals...

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: The two of you certainly seem to fit that criterion, what with your extraordinary temperaments and dress. I wonder if we may have the honor of hosting you at the House?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah... So you want us to attend the princess's wedding at some... house in the mountains...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that in— oh, that's right. We already have the invite.

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: Oh, is that so?

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: ...Ah, looks like this is all the work of fate. The two of you are destined to be guests of the House of Hesperides, no matter how the invite falls into your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: In that case, simply take the invite and show it when you arrive at the House of Hesperides. That will get you into Lady Pavlina's wedding...

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: Although I'd dearly love to travel with you, I have yet to complete the task Lady Pavlina has given me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's fine. We'll find our way to that... um... whatever house you were talking about! That name's too darn long!

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: Heh. I wish the both you a most pleasant time at the House, then...

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhhh... but...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The wedding's already over.

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: Is... the wedding... over?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Scheskaya told me what happened at the House...

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: Ah, my Lady... in the end, nothing has changed.

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: But all that pain, all that resentment, everything that tortured her spirit, did go away in the end...

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: *Sigh* I suppose that does mean that she did find release in the end... didn't she?

dialogues.text: So, you mean to say, you want to invite us to this princess's wedding? "Pavlina"... she sounds like a Snegurochka.

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: That is entirely correct, little minion.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Tsk, Paimon already told you, Paimon's not a minion... But you know, {NICKNAME}, from what Paimon has heard, here in Snezhnaya a love marriage between a Snegovik and a human isn't all that common...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Much less a wedding involving a Snegovik princess. This could turn out to be real interesting...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Pavlina...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? What is it, Goggles?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: The name... feels a little familiar. It comes up when I do a search of my memories.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? Could this princess have anything to do with Goggles then...?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: That is highly possible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Great! Then we definitely have to go then!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Even if we don't end up finding what Goggles is looking for, it's gonna be fun anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... Um... Miss. How do we get to that wedding, then?

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: It will be our utmost pleasure to welcome you at the wedding... Take this invite, please. All you have to do is show the invite when you arrive at the House of Hesperides...

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: Ah, dear guests, please remember to... head to the House of Hesperides to attend Lady Pavlina's wedding!

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: *Sigh* My Lady, although nothing has changed, I hope...

dialogues.speaker: Myeshskaya
dialogues.text: ...your soul can find true rest in the end.
